title: Business Manager/ Change Expert - Client Services Business
full_description:
WithinClient Services Businesswe are looking for aBusiness Managerwho acts as a trusted advisor and run strategic projects! Do you want to be involved in strategic initiatives and work closely together with the CS Business leadership team?
The teamYou will report to the Head of Transformation of Client Services Business and will be part of theTransformation AreaforClient Services Business. We consists out of 5 capabilities: i) Reporting & Data Analysis, ii) Training, iii) Business Analysis, iv) Change Experts, v) Central Support (Communication, User Access Management and Incident Management)
Roles & ResponsibilitiesAs a Business Manager you work directly with the Head of Transformation, the Area Lead Client Services Business and its management team. You will take on a wide range of responsibilities, serving as the “right hand” for the Area Lead and Head of Transformation in his/her daily responsibilities.
You will operate on a strategic, tactical and operational level. Concretely this means contributing towards strategy development, preparing management meetings and transformation steering committees, organising offsites and coordinating key organisation transformations in the domain.
Support the Area Lead and Head of Transformation in any daily, weekly or monthly recurring activities, like preparation of the MT, creation of presentations and communication
Support any activities related to the CS Business strategy, such as townhalls and offsites
Ensure strategic people topics/priorities are addressed as well as driving the execution in cooperation with the Change Expert responsible for the People pillar
Ensure targets of CS Business are met by contributing to the monitoring and strategic steering
Act as linking pin & responsible for relationship with other business functions (e.g. Client Services Retail or Business/Wholesale Banking)
Support Head of Transformation and Area Lead with a variety of business management support activities
Act as the representative (or as delegate) at meetings on strategy or implementation for Client Services Business
Drive (small) projects or workstreams depending on priorities and experience
We are looking for a colleague who does not shy away from a chalenge and feel comfortable managing stakeholders. As Business Manager you will also need to be:
Collaborative person who listens & invest in others to achieve common goals
Effective team player with good interpersonal and communication skills
Excellent in problem-solving, with a strong attention to detail and you have the ability to translate complex matters into simple terms
Highly effective in planning & organization, and delivering results and meet commitments
Experienced delivering clear and compelling presentations
Ability to work independently on various projects & activities at the same time, often under tight deadlines and able to prioritize your time accordingly
Ability to be a trusted advisor with the CS Business MT
You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems
Experience in usage of Office tools, especially Powerpoint (and Excel). Advantage is knowledge on industry tools such asThinkCel
Relevant experience in operations or knowledge of the Business Banking or Wholesale Banking segment
Excellent level of English and ideally Frech and/or Dutch
Hiring manager: Aleksandar Bosnjak
